principles: The intact VESSEL-03 module graph and VESSEL-04 voxel layout remain immutable reference authority.
Every intact voxel placement receives one VESSEL-05 condition state; condition never silently regenerates placement geometry.
Missing construction and removed modules become spatially absent, while damaged and destroyed hardware may remain as residual wreckage material.
Missing construction, incomplete construction, teardown removal, salvage removal, damage, destruction, mothballing, and abandonment remain distinguishable.
Condition produces effective surviving graphs and a residual voxel field rather than deleting provenance from the intact reference records.
Seventy-five percent destruction retains coherent wreck authority and one hundred percent destruction removes all coherent effective topology.
Residual mass, volume, salvageable material, capacities, route survival, voxel occupancy, and readiness recalculate from surviving participation.
Secondary propagation records deterministic lifecycle consequences; combat hit localization remains deferred to VESSEL-08.
